description_for_human: One options trade a day. Scored overnight. Pushed to your phone at 9:50 ET, right before the 10:00 entry. Free MCP endpoint with 18 tools.
description_for_model: GammaRips is a paper-trading options engine. It produces at most one trade idea per weekday, published at ~09:50 ET (right before the 10:00 ET entry), with a pre-set stop (-30% on the option), pre-set target (+40%), and a same-day exit (flat at 15:45 ET on the entry day, no overnight hold). Primary tool: get_todays_pick returns the single bullish pick for today or null. Secondary tools: get_enriched_signals, get_signal_detail, get_win_rate_summary, get_open_position, get_daily_report. Full tool list at https://gammarips.com/mcp.json. Paper-trading performance, educational only. Not investment advice.
